results.overview: This classic story revolves around Captain Pod and his obsession with a huge whale, Moby Dock. The sole survivor of a ship narrates the tale of the captain's obsession.
Robert McNode, who serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed, embarks on a relentless, globe-trotting quest for vengeance when a long-time girl friend is murdered.
Mr. Pod keeps starting, crashing, starting, and then crashing again in an endless loop.
Kube is filled with deeper meaning than what meets the surface - it's a philosophical study about human life.

An exploration of how the actions of individual lives impact one another in the past, present and future, as one soul is shaped from a killer into a hero, and an act of kindness ripples across centuries to inspire a revolution.

Fifty-seven years after surviving an apocalyptic attack aboard her space vessel by merciless space creatures, Officer Ripley awakens from hyper-sleep and tries to warn anyone who will listen about the predators.
Jack Torrance accepts a winter job managing an isolated server farm. As the weeks pass, the sidecar container attached to his pod begins whispering terrible secrets only he can hear.

Jules Winnfielder and Vincent Kubernine are hitmen navigating the dark underbelly of a microservices architecture. Their stories interweave across namespaces, time zones, and one very mysterious manifest.yaml.
After a painful breakup, Joel discovers a startup that can purge all stateful sessions from a cluster. But as the deletion runs, he realizes some persistent volumes are worth keeping.
Left for dead after his deployment is mauled by a runaway ReplicaSet, engineer Hugh deploys a vengeance pod and crawls across a frozen cloud environment to reclaim what was taken from him.
A specialist who plants routing rules inside software-defined networks takes on one final, impossible job: to install a path deep within a target's ingress controller before the connection times out.
When a deranged agent of chaos deploys malicious workloads across Gotham's production cluster, the Kubernetes Caped Crusader must sacrifice his own namespace to protect the city.
In a society governed by strict node taints, spirited pod Elizabeth Daemonset defies the scheduling rules to find her perfect node. A sweeping romantic drama about prejudice and cluster harmony.
Agent Ethan Hunt must execute a zero-downtime rolling deployment in a hostile production environment. Should he or any member of his DevOps force be caught, the Ops team will disavow all knowledge.
Sent into the depths of a rogue production cluster, engineer Willard must find and terminate the notorious Kurtz.io — a Helm release that has gained sentience and declared itself a god.
During the Great Container Purge, a shrewd industrialist uses his private Docker registry to save hundreds of images from being permanently deleted and lost to entropy forever.

Drought and poor resource allocation have forced the Node family off their home cluster. They pack everything into a battered Kubernetes manifest and drive west in search of a region with sufficient CPU.
Three hundred pods, imprisoned in a criminally under-provisioned namespace, devise the most ambitious escape through resource quotas in cloud computing history.
When the senior engineers are pulled into an all-hands incident response, a scrappy team of juniors must manage their very own Kubernetes namespace. There's no crying in DevOps.
Two data volumes, bound together by a Persistent Volume Claim, find hope and eventual freedom through decades of patient I/O operations and the unbreakable will to survive a cluster restart.
